auditMethod: Read PE/CLR/native-resource structures and managed assembly metadata without running the entry point; source review for persistence and lifecycle.

portableExecutable.executionArchitecture: AnyCPU; native process architecture follows the installed .NET Framework and operating system

frameworkDependencies.minimumApiNote: Control.DeviceDpi requires .NET Framework 4.7 or newer. The documented target is Windows 10/11 with .NET Framework 4.8. CLR assembly reference version 4.0 does not imply compatibility with every earlier Framework 4.x release.

embeddedResources.iconArtwork: Original folder-and-bars artwork; no external icon packs

persistenceSourceReview.explicitFileWrite: Only the user-requested CSV export; FileMode.CreateNew prevents overwriting an existing destination.
explicitExternalActions: Open selected location in Windows Explorer

scopeAndLimits: Size and SHA-256 are intentionally excluded here so the descriptive audit does not freeze a pre-final build identity; the runtime test records the executable it actually tests.

The runtime smoke test observes an isolated copied application directory plus redirected TEMP, TMP, APPDATA, and LOCALAPPDATA folders; it does not prove the absence of writes in every operating-system location.
No test or application code erases Windows-maintained execution history, security records, icon caches, or recycle-bin metadata. Deleting the EXE removes the application itself.
Long-path scanning uses native extended-length Win32 paths; shell actions and user-selected export destinations remain subject to their respective Windows API limits.
